    Handle env file quoting edge cases
    
    The .env parser silently mishandled escape sequences in double-quoted
    values, had no inline comment stripping, and ignored the common
    `export` prefix. This led to wrong values for keys containing
    backslash escapes like `\"`, `\\`, `\n`, and `\t`.
    
    - Process escape sequences in double-quoted values (`\"`, `\\`, `\n`,
      `\t`, `\$`); unrecognised escapes preserve the backslash
    - Keep single-quoted values literal (no escape processing)
    - Strip inline comments (` # ...`) from unquoted values
    - Strip optional `export` prefix from lines
    - Add 15 edge-case tests covering all new behaviour
